params.prompt: Cinematic photoreal macro shot, square 1:1, dark warm palette (#0B0907 shadows). Lower half of the frame: a modern studio condenser microphone with a dark matte body and brass grille details on a short stand on a dark desk, angled slightly toward the viewer; a short glowing yellow (#FDD506) sound-wave made of a few thin vertical bars floats in front of the grille, like one short spoken command. Thin haze, golden dust in the light beam, shallow depth of field. The upper 50% of the frame is nearly black and empty for typography. No people, no readable text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.
